name: Neural Cloud Shading with Triplane Encoding
definition: A real-time rendering method that uses a neural network (MLP) to shade cloud surfaces. It reconstructs inputs (position, thickness, shadowing) via rasterization pre-passes and evaluates the MLP in the fragment shader to produce color and transparency, blending with the background.
summary: Neural Cloud Shading with Triplane Encoding is a real-time rendering method that replaces volumetric ray marching with a neural shading model applied to mesh geometry, using triplane feature encoding to capture view-dependent opacity and parallax.
